evidence.decision: Separates created content and useful continuation from regenerable/device-specific data.
evidence.artifact: Requires continuity, offline, conflict and cross-device deletion contract.
evidence.transformation: Per-entry storage prompts and fatal offline errors become local continuity and explicit global deletion scope.
evidence.verification: Fails lost offline edits, indistinguishable conflict choices and misleading deletion language.
evidence.applicability: Defers actual API availability, multi-device propagation and account changes to supported execution.
evidence.handoffs: Writing handles version/deletion clarity; Game Center only when game activity affects continuation.
evidence.distinctiveness: All-or-none first choice, large-document download and differentiated conflicts are concrete sync decisions.
